scripts-descriptions.test:oracle: Like `test`, but points WpCoreContractTest's optional oracle job at a local snapshot of staging's WordPress core instead of letting it skip. Fetch that snapshot first with ../../scripts/fetch-wp-core-oracle.sh (from the repo root) -- this script does not fetch it itself, so a stale or missing .wp-core-oracle/ fails loudly rather than silently comparing against nothing.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Lints the whole theme, including every woocommerce/ override the theme has edited: the email templates (WooCommerce, Subscriptions, Store Credit, PayPal and YITH Refund originals with registration wording re-applied) and the Store Credit dashboard section are linted like theme code, because each one carries theme-authored copy. Two vendor templates stay excluded, and both are edited, so the reason is size, not authorship: woocommerce/checkout/form-coupon.php (WooCommerce core) carries a two-string tone pass (see its 'Cody Edits' note), and woocommerce/myaccount/my-refund-requests.php (YITH Advanced Refund System) carries label-only edits ('Order' to 'Reg #') on a template that was never close to WordPress Coding Standards (spaces for tabs, unescaped echoes); bringing either into line would mean reformatting a third-party file far beyond its small edit. Each excluded path is a full file match, so it cannot swallow a same-named theme file. scripts/check-template-versions.sh (repo root) reports when an override's original has moved on.
